span.p:
1. Control plane upgrade
(no workload restart; API stays available)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Node pools one AZ at a time:
maxSurge 1 / maxUnavailable 0,
cordon → drain (PDB respected) → reimage,
node soak time before next node

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Guardrails per StatefulSet
• ≥ 3 replicas, one per AZ (topologySpreadConstraints)
• PDB maxUnavailable 1
• Premium_ZRS / StandardSSD_ZRS disks: pod can move zone
• readiness gates on replication / quorum

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
When
• patch + node image: auto-upgrade channels inside
planned maintenance windows (dev → acc → prd staggered)
• LTS minor: once per LTS cycle, rehearsed in dev and acc
